name: Daily Stock Analysis
description: Scheduled stock analyst for A-share, Hong Kong and US tickers that combines market data and news into LLM reports pushed to chat apps.
whatItDoes: Produces a daily decision-style briefing for a watchlist and delivers it by messaging channels such as Telegram or email. Individual investors can run it locally, on a schedule or free through GitHub Actions.
howItWorks: A Python job pulls quotes and news from several data sources, asks an LLM to analyse each stock and formats the result for notification channels. It also offers a web UI and scheduling flags, all configured through an env file.

requirements.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
requirements.description: One model key is needed; OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or AIHUBMIX_KEY are alternatives

requirements.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
requirements.description: One of the optional notification channels
